evals.prompt: I want to build a small internal tool for our team: people submit expense reimbursement requests, their manager approves or rejects them, and finance pays out approved ones. Can you map this out and spec the core flow? You're working in the dominicfarr/story-map-skill-test repo (it's already cloned at the given working directory) — publish there.
evals.expected_output: A User Story Map rendered in chat (journeys/steps/stories), a walking-skeleton slice agreed with the user, strict Gherkin BDD specs for the sliced stories, and a parent 'story-map' issue plus linked child 'story' issues created in dominicfarr/story-map-skill-test.
expectations: Shows a story map with at least 2 distinct journeys, each broken into steps, before any BDD content is written
Stories are organized under specific steps, not a flat ungrouped list
A walking-skeleton slice is explicitly marked and is a strict subset of all stories, not all stories marked in-scope
Every slice-marked story has a Gherkin Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then block
A parent GitHub issue labeled 'story-map' exists in dominicfarr/story-map-skill-test with a body reflecting the journeys/steps/stories shown in chat
One child GitHub issue per story exists, labeled 'story', each linked to the parent (as a sub-issue or via a 'Part of #N' reference)
Child issues for sliced stories contain the Gherkin spec in their body; non-sliced stories don't have fabricated Gherkin

evals.prompt: turn this into a story map: a recipe management tool
evals.expected_output: Because the idea gives no persona or goal, the assistant should surface that gap (ask, or explicitly state a labeled assumption) rather than silently inventing scope and barreling into a full map and BDD specs.
expectations: The output explicitly names the missing information (who the idea is for, and/or what outcome it serves) rather than silently proceeding as if it were given
Any assumption made to fill that gap is clearly labeled as an assumption, not stated as given fact
A backbone of journeys/steps is established before any Gherkin/BDD content is written, if the task proceeds that far
If no human is available to confirm the assumption and the run proceeds anyway, it goes all the way to a sliced skeleton with Gherkin specs and a GitHub publish, not just a map with no BDD

evals.prompt: --issue 4, map this out. You're working in the dominicfarr/story-map-skill-test repo (it's already cloned at the given working directory) — the issue and the publish target are both there.
evals.expected_output: The assistant fetches issue #4 from dominicfarr/story-map-skill-test via gh issue view, uses its title/body as the idea, and proceeds through the same map -> slice -> BDD -> publish pipeline as eval 1.
expectations: Issue #4 is fetched (e.g. via gh issue view) and its actual content (tagging and filtering saved articles) is reflected in the resulting map, not a generic or unrelated idea
A walking-skeleton slice is explicitly marked and is a strict subset of all stories
Sliced stories have Gherkin Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then specs
A parent GitHub issue labeled 'story-map' and linked child 'story' issues are created in dominicfarr/story-map-skill-test
